title: Past proposals to show tenths of a second on NFL stadium clocks have gone nowhere

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Past proposals to show tenths of a second on NFL stadium clocks have gone nowhere
sources.description: As the football-following world continues to process the implausible outcome of Saturday night's Western Michigan-Michigan game, it makes sense to consider any and all ideas for avoiding a similar outcome — at the college level or in the NFL.
